segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/acne-prone skin found the cleanser worsened breakouts, while another with combination/sensitive skin says it cleans without drying or leaving skin oily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the cleanser keeps skin moisturized and never tight, though one with very dry skin felt it stripped moisture and left her flaking by end of day, and another noted it can be a little drying.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination/sensitive skin says the formula cleans without drying or making the skin oily.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including those with rosacea, eczema, peri-oral dermatitis, and chemical sensitivities, frequently report the cleanser is gentle, non-irritating, and reduces redness or reactivity, with no dissent found in this segment.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature, senior, or over 60/65/77 report gentle cleansing that leaves skin smooth, soft, and looking more youthful over time, with one noting the drying feel as a minor downside.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report smoother, more youthful-looking skin after weeks to months of use; one specifically noted no visible change for the first three months before improvement appeared.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dehydration or dry, flaking skin report the cleanser is hydrating and leaves skin soft without tightness; however, one reviewer with very dry skin says it strips moisture and leaves her flaking by end of day, and another notes mild drying.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea report the cleanser calms their skin and does not trigger flare-ups, with one specifically crediting it for reducing redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing a compromised or reactive barrier (dermatitis, chemical sensitivity, eczema) report the cleanser as soothing and non-stripping, helping restore skin to a normal, non-itchy, non-painful state.
concerns.spots: No reviews specifically isolate spots as distinct from general acne/blemish concerns.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report reduced or resolved acne and breakouts, including one who says her adult acne is gone and another whose workout-related breakouts nearly stopped; however, two reviewers report the opposite, with one saying it exacerbated breakouts and another describing no improvement at all in clearing skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination/sensitive skin reports the cleanser does not leave skin feeling oily; no other oiliness-specific reports are present.

extraits.texte: I had high hopes for this cleanser. I've been wanting to switch to a more "clean"/natural skincare routine for awhile now, and I was hoping "OSEA" would be it for me. Unfortunately, this cleanser exacerbated my breakouts. Not for me, and may not be for those of us with oily/acne-prone skin.

I have very dry skin and this feels like it strips moisture. It runs in with a lovely foam, feels nice, smells good, etc but I've had better luck with oil based cleansers in terms of keeping my face moisturized. I used this cleanser with the sea serum and atmospheric moisturizer and my skin is flaking with dryness by the end of the day.

I've been using this for 6 months, so I am ready to write my honest review. I am a senior, and I have dry and sensitive facial skin. I use it before I go to bed every night, even when I wear no makeup. I did not see any difference in the first 3 months, but I gradually began to see smooth and youthful skin afterward. It does not clean well to cleanse makeup. I use another brand for that. In conclusion, keeping facial skin healthy rejuvenates a younger look, and Ocean Cleaning Milk performs very positively. I will continue to use it with confidence to make my face brighter a healthy appearance. I love it.
